note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: TypeScript: ts/src/jsonc.ts has `import { Tabnas } from '@tabnas/parser'`, a value import, because `Jsonc` calls `new Tabnas().use(jsonic).parse(grammarText)` to read the embedded grammar; ts/package.json lists @tabnas/parser in peerDependencies. Rust: rs/src/lib.rs has `use tabnas::{Context, GrammarError, GrammarSetting, GrammarSpec, Plugin, PluginError, Tabnas, Value}` and `pub use tabnas::TabnasError as JsoncError`, with `tabnas` (package tabnas-parser) in [dependencies] of rs/Cargo.toml. Go: no .go file under go/, test files included, imports github.com/tabnas/parser/go, and go/go.mod carries the parser as `// indirect`. go/jsonc.go imports no tabnas module but github.com/tabnas/jsonic/go and constructs no engine: `Jsonc` hands `grammarText` to `j.GrammarText` on the instance it is given, and every jsonic identifier it names (`jsonic.Jsonic`, `jsonic.GrammarSetting`, `jsonic.GrammarSettingRule`, `jsonic.GrammarSettingAlt`, `jsonic.Options`, `jsonic.CommentOptions`, `jsonic.RuleOptions`) is an alias of an engine type declared in jsonic's go/engine.go. go/clib/core.go imports jsonic for jsonic's own function `Make` (`host.Make()`).
parser.repair: To agree on having it: go/jsonc.go would import github.com/tabnas/parser/go for the engine types, and the parser line in go/go.mod would become a direct require. Those aliases are all go/jsonc.go takes from jsonic, so moving every one of them would leave that file's jsonic import unused; jsonic would remain a dependency of the Go module through `host.Make` in go/clib/core.go. To agree on not having it: ts/src/jsonc.ts would take `Tabnas` from @tabnas/jsonic, which re-exports it (`export { Tabnas } from '@tabnas/parser'` in jsonic's ts/src/jsonic.ts), and ts/package.json would drop the @tabnas/parser peer. In Rust that move is not available today: tabnas-jsonic re-exports only `TabnasError` (as `JsonicError`), so jsonic's rs/src/lib.rs would first have to re-export the engine's items before rs/src here could take them from it and rs/Cargo.toml drop `tabnas` from [dependencies]. Either way the engine stays in every port's build, because jsonic depends on it in all three (peerDependencies of its ts/package.json, the import in its go/engine.go, [dependencies] of its rs/Cargo.toml). Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
